terms.label: Licence replacement (renewal) application has been submitted
terms.definition: The person has submitted (or is hereby submitting) an application for replacement of the driving licence to the Transport Administration.

anchors.quote: Esmane juhiluba ja juhiluba antakse välja kümne tööpäeva jooksul sellekohase eksami sooritamisele või juhiloa vahetamise taotluse esitamisele järgnevast päevast arvates.
anchors.note: EN: '...issued within ten working days as of the day after which ... an application for replacement of the driving licence was submitted.' The request itself; user-declarable.

terms.label: Valid medical certificate (tervisetõend) on record
terms.definition: A currently valid medical certificate has been issued for the person, delivered via the health information system (tervise infosüsteem) or submitted to the Transport Administration.

anchors.quote: Tervisenõuetele vastavust tõendab tervisekontrolli teostaja väljastatud tervisetõend.
anchors.note: EN: 'Compliance with the medical requirements is proven by a medical certificate issued by the person who carried out the medical examination.'

anchors.quote: ... kui talle ei ole tervise infosüsteemi vahendusel väljastatud või kui ta ise ei esita hiljemalt nimetatud tähtpäeval Transpordiametile uut kehtivat tervisetõendit.
anchors.note: The law itself names the register: the health information system is the electronic channel for the certificate.

terms.label: State fee (riigilõiv) has been paid
terms.definition: The state fee for issuing or replacing the driving licence has been paid.

anchors.quote: Juhiloa väljastamise ja vahetamise eest tuleb tasuda riigilõivu.
anchors.note: EN: 'A state fee is payable for issuing or replacing a driving licence.' Amount set by Riigilõivuseadus.

terms.label: Right to drive is suspended or withdrawn
terms.definition: The person's right to drive has been suspended or withdrawn (LS § 125); established by the data of the motor register (liiklusregister).

anchors.quote: Esmast juhiluba ja juhiluba ei väljastata isikule, kellele ei ole antud juhtimisõigust või kelle juhtimisõigus on peatatud või käesoleva seaduse § 125 kohaselt ära võetud ...
anchors.note: EN: 'A ... driving licence is not issued to a person ... whose right to drive has been suspended or withdrawn in accordance with § 125 of this Act ...' Deny condition.

anchors.quote: Õigust juhtida mootorsõidukit tõendatakse liiklusregistri andmete alusel.
anchors.note: The motor register (liiklusregister) is the authoritative source for the right to drive.

provenance.notes: Teaching example authored 2026-09-02; anchored 2026-09-02 to Liiklusseadus terviktekst RT I, 11.07.2026, 44 and its official English translation.
